verdict.rationale: OpenHands' own site describes a security-alert workflow that reviews alerts, validates the finding, updates affected code, and opens a pull request with the remediation. Its automations can run on a schedule or in response to webhook events, which covers the 'automatically' part. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the security-alert automation (supported alert sources, setup, validation method), and independent or hands-on corroboration; the evidence is a single marketing-page line.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can have security alerts automatically validated and remediated with an opened pull request
